t: This is City Wing, a sculpture by Christopher Le Brun. Le Brun is a British artist known mainly as a painter, so a sculpture from him is a little unusual. He served as President of the Royal Academy of Arts from 2011 to December 2019, and was knighted in the 2021 New Year Honours for services to the arts. City Wing is his work, made by an artist who has spent his career at the centre of British art.
